messages.aff_intro: Partners share a personal link to your shop. When someone who came through it pays, the shop sends a signed message here and the partner's commission waits for your approval.

messages.aff_rotate_warning: The current secret stops working at once. The shop must get the new one before it reports the next order.
messages.aff_snippet_hint: Paste it into every page of the shop. Call PartnerTypeRef.consent() after the visitor agrees to marketing cookies; nothing is stored before that. At checkout send PartnerTypeRef.get() as "ref".
